text: 财政部公布2026年第四季度国债发行安排，其中10月计划发行3期超长期特别国债，期限包括20年、30年和50年；10月计划发行1期中央金融机构注资特别国债，期限5年；10月计划发行两期凭证式储蓄国债，期限包括3年和5年。
text_en: The Ministry of Finance announced the arrangement for the issuance of government bonds in the fourth quarter of 2026, of which three tranches of ultra-long special government bonds are planned for issuance in October, with maturities including 20 years, 30 years and 50 years; one tranche of special government bonds for capital injection into central financial institutions is planned for issuance in October, with a maturity of 5 years; and two tranches of book-entry savings government bonds are planned for issuance in October, with maturities including 3 years and 5 years.
